items.title: Scrap junk to produce Steel
items.detail: Craft Bulk Steel at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it.

items.title: Complete the Quest: Disturbed Grave
items.detail: Finish a public event to receive a Pint-Sized Phantoms' map, then dig up the bloodied grave.

items.title: Cook Grilled Fish while Intoxicated
items.detail: Consume an alcoholic beverage, then cook Grilled Fish at a Cooking Station.

items.title: Kill a Lost during the "Mischief Night" Event
items.detail: Join Mischief Night at Rapidan Camp and kill Lost Dwellers.

items.title: Kill a Mirelurk
items.detail: Fast travel to Spruce Knob Lake for reliable spawns.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Check the Pip-Boy map for an Infestation area and defeat Phantoms at the hotspot.

items.title: Sell Grilled Fish to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Cook Grilled Fish at a Cooking Station and sell it to any NPC vendor.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Enter build menu and construct basic floors at your C.A.M.P. or claimed workshop.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any deep water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is reliable.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Clear a full Infestation event marked on your Pip-Boy map for rare 4-Star legendary loot.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station; yields vary by fish size.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for dependable robot spawns.

items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Consume items like BlamCo Mac and Cheese or Dandy Boy Apples.

items.title: Kill a Floater
items.detail: Fast travel to Solomon's Pond and target the eyes as weak spots.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Defeat masked Phantom cultists at active Infestation hotspots.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night at Rapidan Camp and kill the Phantom that spawns after.

items.title: Repeatable Under Rank 100: Gain XP
items.detail: Earn XP through normal play; only available below Scoreboard rank 100.

items.title: Repeatable at Rank 100 or above: Complete a Public Event
items.detail: Complete any public event; only available at Scoreboard rank 100+.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community building contest challenging players to create C.A.M.P.s or Shelters inspired by classic slasher movies with prizes for finalists and a grand winner.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: A seasonal public event where players light the Mischief Pyre and defend against Lost Dwellers, with Pint-Sized Phantoms as potential encounter bosses.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Daily Ops event offering double mutation rewards and seasonal loot.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Scorched enemies with new rewards available during the period.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Weekend event increasing the chance to catch seasonal fish species with a new local legend fish.
